purpose: Scrub a per-frame PBR flipbook set (PearlWoven/SurrealFabric families) or a 4x4 atlas (Brass_T_Brass_Flipbook_30_Atlas_4x4, Alphas_Sparkles atlases) with a shared time->frame contract. One function serves the Nikki-chain flipbook cloth masters AND the Niagara sparkle materials (plan tiers T3).
authoring_rules: create_custom_hlsl_node ONLY on new function; never build_material_graph on existing assets
vertex-safe: no Parameters.CameraVector inside any path reachable from WPO
single writer: time comes from engine Time via a Time-scalar parameter fed by MPC_Melodia_Palette reader; MF never writes MPC

inputs.TextureArrayOrAtlas: TextureObjectParameter (per-frame mode: user sets frame count)
inputs.AtlasGridSide: StaticSwitch or int scalar: 0 = per-frame mode; 4 = 4x4 atlas chop

frame_math: frame = floor((Time*FrameRate + FrameOffset) mod FrameCount); per-frame mode: caller samples TextureObject(index) via StaticBranch loop OR TextureArray if promoted; atlas mode: uv = (baseUV + float2(frame%G, floor(frame/G))) / G, G=4
open_questions: per-frame textures in git are Texture2D sets; a true VirtualTexture2DArray promotion needs an importer pass - spec first, decide with editor batch F
frame counts per family not yet censored (count files per set in batch F, pre-editor, from disk)
